version.changelog:
- Initial release of “International Communication and Digital Media Management” skill.
- Provides a practical guide to editorial review, digital distribution, translation, discoverability, media monitoring, and ethical communication.
- Outlines core areas including workflow preparation, content review, channel selection, language adaptation, and media monitoring.
- Includes clear learning objectives, a recommended workflow, a quality checklist, and guidance on professional output style.
